required_manual_checks.description: Execution follows apps/os/docs/SLICE-2A3A-EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md (promoted in 2A.3a1) exactly: preconditions P1-P8, steps T0-T13 in order, each step's pass condition, and the section 6 failure row on any failure. No step is skipped, reordered, combined, or replaced by a different command, and no guard or script is modified or bypassed (the scripts and tests are blocked paths here). Any deviation is a STOP and a report, not an improvisation.

Before T1, Oscar records in chat: the deploy SHA and tree (D5: the latest PROMOTED baseline at T0, pinned exactly; the checkpoint commit of this task is documentation only and is never the deployed tree), the window start, and decisions D1 (one stopped-service window), D2 (forward-fix after T7; restore from T2 only as a last resort, decided at the time), D3 (no automated write smoke; T13 is one genuine owner contact), D4 (partner principal, satisfied by PARTNER-PROVISION-REPAIR-001 plus the partner's single sign-in) and D6 (serving-tree hygiene). No authorization, no T1. Task creation, claim and promotion do not authorize execution.

P1-P8 re-established at execution time, not carried over: P1 coordinator verify OK after fetching agents/coord and review/*; P2 full aggregate green (static, server, db, recovery including owner R1b/R1c via prove --owner) for the exact deploy tree; P3 main-checkout serving tree clean at the pin with next.config.ts reverted; P4 no iCloud ' 2'/' 3' duplicates in source or .next; P5 only the launchd com.ascend.os PID on 3001 and no other session or dev server in the main checkout; P6 backup key 0600, pg_dump 18.6, ~/AscendPg17 intact; P7 clean worktree at 8ef09f5 with node_modules; P8 partner can sign in. Each is recorded pass/fail with its command, before T1.

Every production-touching or credential-bearing command (T1-T4, T6-T12) is run by Oscar in his own terminal; the agent may open a command there for Oscar to review and confirm but never types a confirmation, never reads or echoes .env.production.local values, database URLs, the backup key, the owner email or the partner's credentials, and never runs admin commands. The owner email is entered through the scripts' silent prompt. The partner's credentials are typed by the partner or owner with read -rs into ASCEND_SMOKE_PARTNER_EMAIL / ASCEND_SMOKE_PARTNER_PASSWORD for T1 and T11 only, and unset afterwards.

T5 clones .next before the outage. T6 bootout, T7 apply with --service-stopped and --since the T4 record (at most 120 minutes old, ledger unchanged, no moved data key, zero active or unknown sessions), T8 verify 51 passed 0 failed, T9 build in place from the clean committed pinned tree, T10 bootstrap and /login 200 happen in one window, with the build-restart race respected (bootstrap after the build completes). The D1 .next clone is not a rollback once T7 has committed.

T1 baseline on the old build proves discrimination: S/A/B/D, R0, R1, R5 pass and C1-C7, R2-R4 fail as expected with no UNEXPECTED-PASS. T11 on the new build passes every check for owner AND partner, including D1 ledger head 010 and D4/D8 nothing written. T13 is one genuine contact by Oscar on a prospect he is working, confirmed by him.

T2 backup taken from the P7 worktree at 8ef09f5 (A5 not weakened), proven at T3 by R1b then two-leg R1c on 17.6 with every test passed and none skipped, before any migration. T12 after-backup from the deploy tree (ledger 001-010, profile post-010-v1) and its R1b/R1c proof; if T12 fails, 010 stays applied, the T2 artifact is labelled historical for 009 and never current, and the backup is retried.

apps/os/docs/SLICE-2A3A2-CHECKPOINT.md records only what contract section 7 lists: deploy SHA and tree; T2 artifact SHA-256 and T3 pass counts; T4 record digest; the T7 ledger row and T8 51/0; build ID; T11 pass count with the baseline expected-fail list; outage start and end; the T12 artifact and proof; the owner-confirmed T13; plus the P1-P8 results and the T0 decisions. Step outputs live in ~/AscendDeploy/<TS>/ (0700), never in the repository. The checkpoint is scanned for URLs, hosts, emails, passwords, tokens, keys, UUIDs and row content before freeze.

Only migration 010 and the pinned promoted build go live. No other migration, schema, data, credential, grant or configuration change; no Sales feature work (2A.3b onward); no change to the 010 scripts or smoke. The only tracked diff is the checkpoint document.
